jobs.description: <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> US - Remote </p> <p>Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. We are a series C startup with the largest network of independent primary care practitioners for clients.</p> <p>The Recruiting team is looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Recruiter to help grow teams across Elation Health. role requirements and target candidate profiles across departments</li> <li>Be an ambassador of Elation Health's mission and core values throughout the candidate journey</li> <li>Track recruiting practices, and help evaluate new technologies that could improve our hiring process</li> <li>Take on special projects to improve recruiting processes and candidate experience as you grow in the role</li> <li>Partner across both Talent Acquisition and Human Resources, leveraging periods between active hiring cycles to contribute to core HR programs, retention strategies, and team development</li> </ul> <h2>Experience and Skills</h2> <ul> <li>2+ years of experience in full-cycle recruiting</li> <li>Effective communication with hiring teams</li> <li>Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, AI sourcing platforms) to work smarter and more efficiently</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Highly organized with meticulous attention to detail -- you take pride in keeping records accurate and up-to-date</li> <li>Comfortable managing multiple priorities and calendars in a fast-paced environment</li> <li>A proactive, can-do attitude and a strong
